Chandpol bookshop, Jaipur
upper floor above the bangle lane

Dear traveller,

Nandini Sharma here. Please bill this shop and not Prof. Gopal Menaria, who only pointed at the shelf. I wrote the order on 6 Apr 2026 and I want Lane of Marigolds, A Well in Amber and The Postmaster's Map. Pencil prices on my copy are 340, 275 and 190. Proforma 61 from the Delhi fair is a different conversation. Nobody copied the thirteen-digit book code.

Yours,
Nandini

titles.instruction: Each title she asked the traveller to send

shelf_total.instruction: Sum of the pencil prices on her copy

book_code.instruction: Thirteen-digit book code for the order

text: Hail punched the boot, and the car spent a morning moving between garages in Jaipur. The lane shop by the station said 8500 for labour and paint, the authorised counter said 24000, and an uncle's friend said 14750. A new spray booth quoted 19800, a roadside welder quoted 12000, and the shop that wanted a fresh panel quoted 16200, so the bumper is still in the courtyard.

estimate.instruction: Give one repair figure in rupees from the middle of the garages that saw the car.

place.instruction: Which city were the garages in?

text: Kazuwa Machiya, Higashiyama, Kanazawa, for the attention of the manager. I am Naomi Fujimoto, guest on booking KZ-6614. Arrival was 2026-03-21. I write on April 7, 2026 after a poor night. futon was damp. corridor smelled of kerosene. morning miso was cold. Please refund the room charge of 14863 yen and the extra futon at 2684 yen. My friend's separate stay KZ-1044 must not be touched. I was never given a receipt number. Staff spoke of a tourist tax of 450 yen; leave that out of any adjustment. Naomi Fujimoto

grievances.instruction: Each problem she reports from the night

refund_sought.instruction: Room charge and extra futon added together

arrived_on.instruction: Date she arrived at the machiya
